event_text: Thursday: Downdetector reports surge as fans arrive for the South Dakota volleyball tournament in Sioux Falls (about 4:30 PM Central)
notes: Converted from Dakota News Now's 'just after 4:30 p.m.' (Central), which it took from Downdetector; TicketNews repeats it.

event_text: Thursday: most services reportedly restored (shortly before 6 PM Central)
notes: Converted from Dakota News Now's 'just before 6:00 p.m.' (Central). IsItDownRightNow shows outage-level reports until about 10:11 PM ET (c010).

event_text: Friday: doors set to open at the Caesars Superdome for the Usher and Chris Brown show (6 PM Central)
Downdetector complaints about Ticketmaster begin, mostly about the app
notes: Time as given by Hindustan Times, 8:33 PM ET.

event_text: Melbourne, Australia: the first AFLW preliminary final starts at Ikon Park (1:05 PM local, Nov 21); fans are still queuing to get in midway through the first quarter because of the Ticketmaster outage
notes: The Age gives the 1:05 PM AEDT start; 9:05 PM ET is converted. The queues are reported during the first quarter, so after this time.

event_text: Live Nation New Orleans posts that Ticketmaster is having a service outage and sends fans to the box office
notes: The post's exact time was not given; WBRZ's story was stamped 9:17 PM Central (10:17 PM ET) so it is earlier than that. Time here is approximate.

event_text: The Superdome posts video of Usher and Chris Brown on stage; the concert is no longer delayed (about 9 PM Central)
Mexico City: the Auditorio Nacional tells fans with digital tickets to go to the box office because the Ticketmaster system is having intermittent failures (9:14 PM local)
notes: Time of the Instagram notice as given by Reforma, 21:14 Mexico City time.

event_text: John Summit takes the stage at the Kaseya Center in Miami about 15 minutes late, while some fans outside still cannot load their tickets
notes: From Miami New Times (s022); Miami is on Eastern time.

event_text: Mexico City: Los Ángeles Azules go on stage at the Auditorio Nacional, nearly an hour late (9:24 PM local)
notes: Reforma gives 21:24 Mexico City time against a scheduled 20:30.

event_text: Superdome officials say Ticketmaster's problems are mostly resolved, with possible intermittent stops (about 9:30 PM Central)
notes: Converted from WWL; WDSU's 9:35 PM Central update also says the outage was temporarily resolved.

event_text: Ticketmaster Fan Support posts that tickets are displaying properly and other services are back to normal; no cause given
notes: Time from the post itself (05:34 UTC); TicketNews gives 12:34 a.m. Nov 21.

event_text: A Ticketmaster spokesperson sends WWL tips for the second Superdome show and says the issue is cleared up; no cause given
notes: WWL says the email came Saturday afternoon. Its story was published at 3:52 PM Central (4:52 PM ET), so the email came at or before then.
